definitions.explanation: A person who performs to entertain others. In modern Japanese, most commonly refers to comedians (お笑い芸人), but can also refer to other types of performers such as street performers, variety show talents, or traditional entertainers.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{芸人|げいにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{芸人|げいにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Young comedians are active on television.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸人|げいにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{上京|じょうきょう}→上京：03344_joukyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He came up to Tokyo from Osaka aspiring to become a comedian.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern usage, {芸人|げいにん} most often means a comedian, especially an ⟦お{笑|わら}い→お笑い：10298_owarai⟧{芸人|げいにん} (comedy entertainer). Japanese comedy culture, centered in Osaka and Tokyo, is a major part of the TV entertainment industry. Many {芸人|げいにん} work in pairs (⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧) performing manzai or conte.

The word can also refer more broadly to any performer or entertainer, including {大道|だいどう}{芸人|げいにん} (street performer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{笑|わら}い→お笑い：10298_owarai⟧{芸人|げいにん}: comedian
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{芸人|げいにん}: young/up-and-coming comedian
- {大道|だいどう}{芸人|げいにん}: street performer
- ⟦{売|う}れっ{子|こ}→売れっ子：12110_urekko⟧{芸人|げいにん}: popular comedian
- {芸人|げいにん}{魂|だましい}: entertainer's spirit
